entries.title: Psalms 85:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm.>> Thou hast been favourable, Jehovah, unto thy land; thou hast turned the captivity of Jacob:

entries.title: Psalms 85:2
segments: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people; thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 85:3
segments: Thou hast withdrawn all thy wrath; thou hast turned from the fierceness of thine anger.

entries.title: Psalms 85:4
segments: Bring us back, O God of our salvation, and cause thine indignation toward us to cease.

entries.title: Psalms 85:5
segments: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger from generation to generation?

entries.title: Psalms 85:6
segments: Wilt thou not revive us again, that thy people may rejoice in thee?

entries.title: Psalms 85:7
segments: Shew us thy loving-kindness, O Jehovah, and grant us thy salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 85:8
segments: ¶I will hear what *God, Jehovah, will speak; for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his godly ones: but let them not turn again to folly.

entries.title: Psalms 85:9
segments: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.

entries.title: Psalms 85:10
segments: Loving-kindness and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other:

entries.title: Psalms 85:11
segments: Truth shall spring out of the earth, and righteousness shall look down from the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 85:12
segments: Jehovah also will give what is good, and our land shall yield its increase.

entries.title: Psalms 85:13
segments: Righteousness shall go before him, and shall set his footsteps on the way.
